verdict.rationale: Scribe returns transcripts as structured API responses, with the original kept under `result` and polished text under `outputs.text_polishing.text`. Batch mode can write each transcript into the customer's own S3 prefix next to its input file. Vocabulary Assets can be listed via GET and deleted via DELETE, so the user's main artifacts can be retrieved and removed. There is no documented bulk 'export all my data' capability and no account exit or data-deletion process. missing for 10: explicit bulk data export of all stored data, documented open/standard output formats (e.g., JSON schema, SRT/VTT), account deletion and data-retention guarantees, independent corroboration.
